functions.description: Create a new goxios instance with default configuration
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.name: create

parameters.description: JSON configuration string with baseURL, headers, timeout defaults
parameters.name: config

functions.description: Set global default configuration for all requests
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.example:
const result = goxios.call('setDefaults', JSON.stringify({timeout: 10000, headers: {'User-Agent': 'MyApp/1.0'}}));
console.log('Defaults set:', result.success);
functions.name: setDefaults

parameters.description: JSON configuration string with default settings
parameters.name: config

functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.example:
const defaults = goxios.call('getDefaults');
console.log('Current defaults:', defaults.config);
functions.name: getDefaults

functions.description: Add a request interceptor function called before every HTTP request
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field if argument is not a function
functions.example:
const result = goxios.call('addRequestInterceptor', (config) => { config.headers = { ...config.headers, 'X-Custom': 'value' }; return config; });
// result: { success: true, count: 1 }
functions.name: addRequestInterceptor

parameters.description: Function(config) => config called before each request
parameters.name: interceptorFn

functions.description: Add a response interceptor function called after every HTTP response
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field if argument is not a function
functions.example:
const result = goxios.call('addResponseInterceptor', (response) => { console.log('status:', response.status); return response; });
// result: { success: true, count: 1 }
functions.name: addResponseInterceptor

parameters.description: Function(response) => response called after each response
parameters.name: interceptorFn

functions.description: Remove all registered request and response interceptors
functions.example:
const result = goxios.call('clearInterceptors');
// result: { success: true, requestCleared: 1, responseCleared: 1 }
functions.name: clearInterceptors

functions.description: Get the current state of the circuit breaker (closed, open, or half-open)
functions.example:
const state = goxios.call('getCircuitBreakerState');
// state: { state: 'closed', failureCount: 0, successCount: 0, threshold: 5, timeout: 30000 }
functions.name: getCircuitBreakerState

functions.description: Manually reset the circuit breaker to the closed (normal) state
functions.example:
const result = goxios.call('resetCircuitBreaker');
// result: { success: true, oldState: 'open', newState: 'closed' }
functions.name: resetCircuitBreaker

functions.description: Configure the circuit breaker failure threshold and recovery timeout
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field if config is missing
functions.example:
const result = goxios.call('configureCircuitBreaker', { threshold: 5, timeout: 30000 });
// result: { success: true, threshold: 5, timeout: 30000 }
functions.name: configureCircuitBreaker

parameters.description: Configuration object with optional 'threshold' (failure count to open) and 'timeout' (ms before half-open retry)
parameters.name: config

functions.description: Enable/disable silent mode for console logs
functions.example: goxios.call('setSilentMode', true); // returns true and enables silent mode
functions.name: setSilentMode

parameters.description: true to enable silent mode, false to disable it
parameters.name: silent

functions.description: Get list of all available functions in the module
functions.example:
const functions = goxios.call('getAvailableFunctions');
console.log('Available functions:', functions);
functions.name: getAvailableFunctions
